# COR091 `exit-or-cycle-in-unlabelled-loop`

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="info" text="opt-in" />

An `exit` or `cycle` appears in a DO loop that has no construct name.

## Why

In nested loops a bare `exit`/`cycle` acts on the innermost loop only, which is easy to misread.
Naming the loop and the statement (`exit cells`) states which loop is meant.

## Reported

```fortran
do i = 1, n
  if (done(i)) exit
end do
```

## Preferred

```fortran
cells: do i = 1, n
  if (done(i)) exit cells
end do cells
```

## Suppressing

For one occurrence, with the reason on the same line (or alone on the line before the statement):

```fortran
! fobis: ignore[COR091] <why this occurrence is fine>
```

For the whole project, `ignore = COR091` in the fobos [`[lint]` section](/cookbook/analysis#choose-the-rules).

## Equivalent

Fortitude rule `C142` (see [Lint Rules](/lint-rules/#relation-to-fortitude)).
